# Matcap swap

Shades any material from a matcap: a picture of a lit sphere looked up by the surface direction, for clay, chrome or candy looks without lights. A soft clay matcap is built in; set your own image to swap it.

<EffectDemo effect="matcap" />

## Usage

```ts
import { patchMaterial } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { matcap } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/matcap';

const effect = matcap({ preset: 'clay' });
patchMaterial(mesh.material, effect);
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => renderer.render(scene, camera));
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.map = null`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type                    | Default     | Range | Description                                                            |
| --------- | ----------------------- | ----------- | ----- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `map`     | 2D texture              | `null`      |       | The matcap image (sRGB). Without one, a built-in clay matcap is used.  |
| `tint`    | hex color               | `'#d9cfc4'` |       | Color multiplied into the matcap.                                      |
| `mode`    | 'replace' \| 'multiply' | `'replace'` |       | Use the matcap as the shading, or multiply it into the material's own. |
| `amount`  | number                  | `1`         | 0 – 1 | Mix between the original shading and the matcap.                       |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset   | Settings                              |
| -------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `clay`   | `tint: '#d9cfc4'`                     |
| `jade`   | `tint: '#5fbf8f'`                     |
| `tinted` | `mode: 'multiply'`, `tint: '#ffffff'` |
| `half`   | `amount: 0.5`                         |

Apply one with `matcap({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Materials · tracked as story X12.10 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Kind:** material effect. `patchMaterial(material, effect)` splices it into MeshBasic, Lambert, Phong, Standard, Physical, Toon and Matcap materials, so lighting, fog and shadows keep working; `unpatchMaterial` removes it. See [material effects](/guide/materials).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 7.4 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/matcap`, including the shared effect runtime.

## Credits

Original implementation (MIT). References: Material capture lookup (Sloan et al., The lit sphere, 2001) with three.js MeshMatcapMaterial’s perspective correction.

## Related

- [Toon shading](./toon) — Cel shading on any lit material: the light snaps into flat bands (or follows a ramp you draw) while each surface keeps its color, the highlight becomes one flat spot, and an optional hard rim outlines the silhouette.
- [Triplanar mapping](./triplanar) — Wraps a texture around any shape without UVs: it is projected along the three axes and blended by how much the surface faces each, in world space (so it stays put while objects move) or object space (so it moves with them).
